questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is about to curve or become narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right side of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Red, yellow, green.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that traffic signals are ahead at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or crossing.
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers about a school zone or school crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.correctAnswerText: Work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This orange warning sign alerts drivers that roadwork is coming up ahead. Watch for temporary traffic control devices when driving through a work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: A construction flagger is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flag person is ahead. Always follow their directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests, yellow-green shirts, or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through work zones and allow workers or construction vehicles to cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: School zone ahead
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs tell you that you are in or approaching a school zone and/or school crossing. Watch for children and obey posted speed limits in school zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you about a winding road ahead with multiple curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you to slow down because the road will change direction sharply and suddenly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: This five-sided sign shows you are near a school. Watch for children and stop if they are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending and you need to merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: When you see a railroad crossing sign, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left or continue straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows your lane splits into two directions. You can turn left or go straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Merging traffic from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign warns that traffic is merging from the right, so be prepared to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This low clearance sign shows the height from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this case, it is 12 feet 6 inches.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about upcoming hazards. Orange warning signs indicate construction or maintenance areas ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Upcoming intersection.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to potential hazards ahead. This sign warns of an upcoming intersection so you can prepare for traffic or be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared to stop if the light is flashing.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow sign shows a traffic signal symbol and warns you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to respond to it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and prepare to stop or yield before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red light like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop before entering the intersection. Yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look both ways and listen for trains. Be ready to stop if you see or hear a train approaching. Never try to beat a train across the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrian crossing.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to watch for pedestrians crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians pass before you proceed. Stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downgrade ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes before going down the hill.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop to let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging from another road. Check your mirrors and change lanes if possible to give merging drivers a safe path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that the right lane is ending. Be prepared for drivers to merge into your lane.
